basic_info.description: Experience modern amenities behind a timeless Victorian facade in this recently renovated 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home located on a tree-lined street in the desirable Northwest slope of Bernal Heights. The main level features a distinguished living room which offers a gas fireplace with marble surround and tall ceilings. A formal dining room leads to the open concept kitchen, boasting sleek countertops, high-end appliances, and ample workspace, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. A sidelight-accented glass door opens to the beautifully maintained landscaped patio. One bedroom is adjacent to the dining room, and the recently updated bathroom off the kitchen with marble tile throughout leads you to the second office/bedroom, with built-in cabinetry and desk, perfect for a secluded home office or creative space. French doors open to the patio. The upper level primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a freestanding gas fireplace, two large skylights, and opens to the en-suite bathroom. The laundry and a 2-car tandem garage are on the lower level. Ideally situated in a coveted pocket of Bernal Heights, this home offers easy access to shops, restaurants, cafes, and parks as well as public transit, tech shuttles and freeway. This home is the epitome of Bernal Heights living.
